svg.title: Governance and enforcement: one guard registry read at two run points, and the 2026-09-01 ruling that splits a decidable claim (which may refuse) from everything else (which warns) — with the override log that would close the loop still unbuilt.
svg.text: Governance and Enforcement — One Guard Registry, Two Run Points
A deterministic gate may assert only what is mechanically decidable; everything else warns. Tree at commit b7555b5b5.
ONE DEFINITION — the guard registry lives in vault/tools/lib/, and no gate may amend it
build_guards.py — 573 lines · the checks
16 guards, each a pure function returning the problems it found, each naming
its harm in one sentence. build-no-studio-identity stops every unzipped box
from beginning life as the same Studio; build-no-absolute-paths caught three
maintainer scripts hard-coded to one machine, one paste from public (v1.90).
12 of the 16 read the assembled box; the other 4 read only pre-build inputs.
release_gates.py — 422 lines · the schedule
PHASES — five, ordered, closed: lock-static · candidate · pre-freeze ·
pre-outward-fire · post-publication-reconcile.
INPUT_FIRST_AVAILABLE maps 33 inputs to when each first exists in the world;
a gate declares only its inputs and first_evaluable_phase() takes the latest.
No refusal_class → refused at registration. Gates describe; the registry decides.
TWO RUN POINTS
calls the checks directly, in sequence
one definition, two readers
builds its roster from it
tropo-build-release.py — the build's own reader
Imports build_guards; does not import release_gates.
It calls the checks directly, in sequence — so the box fails at the first
guard on each attempt. v1.94's build failed at its first guard on each of
eight attempts (tropo-release-preflight.py:590-591).
SEQUENTIAL — one defect per attempt
tropo-release-preflight.py — 1,035 lines · the roster
Registers 23 gates unconditionally; 34 once the publisher hands in its
outward verifiers — 6 lock-static governance rows, 16 build guards,
11 pre-outward-fire rows, plus ship-python-floor. No row names its own
phase: 4 guards land at lock-static, before a build is attempted; 12 at candidate.
45 REGISTRY TESTS GREEN
EXERCISED END TO END ONCE (v1.95)
v1.95's first candidate: all 12 box gates in one pass — 10 PASS, 2 REFUSED (f015ba71c711).
WHAT A GATE MAY ASSERT — the ruling that changed the standard, 2026-09-01 · .tropo-studio/memory/entries/f015eb797361.md
"fail loudly, but allow for easy human override with a strong lean towards fixing issues with the inputs into the machinery at the root cause."
The cold-boot invariant (sacrosanct)
The validate gate may WARN on a hand-written file but
must never hard-reject it. TROPO-CONTROL.md §5, ADR-044.
Is the claim mechanically DECIDABLE?
Shape, not truth.
The reflex it retires: "add a check to the gate"
19 v1.94 acceptance criteria carried malformed command
fields. Routing: "route them to Argus as inputs to fix."
NO — warns
YES — may refuse
WARN — and route it to a person
Everything not mechanically decidable warns. The validate-time gate is
warn-by-construction: on FAIL findings tropo-rebuild-vault.py prints them
and completes the rebuild anyway, exiting 8 (:345-355, :627-632).
WORKED — lock-verify-commands-runnable, preflight:432: reading each
whitespace token of a verify command as a path made this gate refuse two
TRUE rows at the v1.95 ignition. Loosened to a warn, citing this ruling.
REFUSED — with a named class
A decidable claim may refuse. GateOutcome returns a typed verdict — pass,
refused, operational-error, skipped-inputs-absent — never a bare exit code,
plus a refusal_class, so a caller branches on the kind of failure.
WORKED — preflight:339-347: an unresolvable `python3 -m unittest` id IS
decidable (static ast.parse, never import), and the harm is a spec locked
carrying a criterion nobody can ever run. Kept as a refusal, same ruling.
override must be easy AND logged
THE OVERRIDE LOG — RULED, NOT BUILT. Clause 2's logging half and all of clause 3 rest on an artifact that does not exist.
28 distinct event types across 14,094 events in vault/events/streams/*.jsonl and vault/events/00-events.jsonl; none matches override | waiv | exempt | disposition.
The right shape exists once, by hand: principal_disposition: accepted_with_exceptions in vault/files/f0152fdb44ff.md — defined by no capsule, read by no tool.
Clause 3 has no instrument. Nearest: three frozen shrink-only debt baselines (22, 22 and 269 rows, .tropo/*-debt-baseline.json) record what is exempt — not who overrode it, or why.
built, in use
proven — has run
warn path / unproven
refuse path / not built
dashed = does not exist yet
